evaluationBoundary: These 16 development cases exercise contracts and support paired review. They are not a held-out benchmark, live-provider result, real-audio test or proof of semantic correctness. References are acceptable illustrations, not exact-match targets. Schema acceptance must be reported separately from human judgments.

scoring.fidelity: Human judgment: retain all propositions, correction targets, negation, uncertainty, conditions and their scope. A critical contradiction or invented fact fails the case regardless of style.
scoring.light: Human judgment: remove verbal clutter, make natural sentences, retain the narrative order and the speaker's voice. Do not demand visible edits to already clear text.
scoring.structure: Human judgment: group genuine topics or explicit steps, attach late clarifications correctly, preserve detail and sequence. Bullets alone do not earn a grouping pass.
scoring.auto: Compare resolvedMode with acceptableAutoModes and independently judge the resulting task. The routing label does not prove the task was done.
scoring.protocol: Machine check: valid mode, text, complete contiguous source ranges and unchanged source identities. This check does not establish semantic fidelity.
scoring.comparison: Use the identical SourceItems, model configuration and formatRules for baseline and candidate; blind the prompt version during human review. Keep failed/rejected responses in denominators. Record latency and calls separately. Do not tune against future held-out cases.
